results.what: No mathematical content on this side; printed publisher's order form reused as scrap paper, with recto formulas showing through. Provides a dating clue (form lists Weierstrass Werke Bd. 4 and Schering Ges. Werke, both 1902) giving an approximate terminus post quem for the notes on folio 3r.

deep.surprise_reason: The page carries only a printed book-order form. Dedekind's reuse of publisher's slips and other scrap paper is well known. The only value is an approximate ≥1902 dating of the recto's notes.
transcription_corrections: Heading is the truncated 'Bestel[lzettel]' (order form), printed with a decorative border; 'Herrn' is in script type.
Line 3 note should read '(Nichtgewünschtes gef[älligst durchstreichen])', truncated by the cut edge.
Weierstrass entry: 'Mathematisch[e Werke ... ] die Theorie der Abelschen T[ranscendenten]', i.e. Werke Bd. 4, 'Vorlesungen über die Theorie der Abelschen Transcendenten'.
The transcription should note that the faint handwritten formulas visible on the image are mirror-image show-through of folio 3r, not writing on 3v.
